title: BAT-GLIMPSE
description: BAT-GLIMPSE is an open-source Swift/BAT localization pipeline for transient gamma-ray sources. It combines coded-mask imaging and mosaic techniques to recover arcminute-scale positions during both normal pointings and spacecraft slews, enabling rapid follow-up of short transients and multi-messenger counterparts.
notes: Cite this software with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20692675 and the BAT-GLIMPSE paper (arXiv:2607.15130).
